title: Your AI assistant can now manage your bookings
excerpt: “Book Anna in for a massage on Friday at 14:00.”
content_html:
“Book Anna in for a massage on Friday at 14:00.”

That is all you have to say to your AI assistant now. No logging in, no clicking through a calendar — the booking just happens. Or ask “what does Thursday look like?” and get your schedule back in plain language, wherever you happen to be typing.

Today we are launching an MCP server for MakePlans, and this is exactly what it lets you do.

Since day one MakePlans has had an API. Our view has always been that your data is your data, and that you should be able to connect MakePlans to whatever tools you use — not the other way around. AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT are quickly becoming a tool many of you use every day, so connecting them to your bookings was the obvious next step.

MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open standard that lets AI assistants connect to external services. And open standard is the important part here. We did not build a Claude plugin or a ChatGPT plugin. We built one integration based on an open protocol, and any assistant or agent that speaks MCP can use it — the ones that exist today and the ones that will exist next year. That is how we prefer to build things. No proprietary plugin stores, no lock-in.

What you can do

Once connected, your assistant can work with your MakePlans account:

  • Check availability and find open slots
  • List your services and events
  • Look up customers
  • Create and cancel bookings

Your assistant talks to MakePlans the same way our own applications do. Read more about what this makes possible on our AI booking assistant page.

A note on access

The MCP server is for you, the business. It connects using your own MakePlans API credentials, with the same access as our private API. It is not something your end-customers connect their assistants to — your customer data stays exactly where it always has: in your account, under your control.

And as with everything else we build: this is an addition, not a replacement. The admin panel, the API, the integrations — everything works as before. If AI assistants are not your thing, nothing changes for you.

Setup instructions are available on our developer site. If you run into anything odd, or your assistant does something clever we did not think of, we would love to hear about it.

content_html_zh:
“预订安娜周五 14:00 享受按摩服务。”

这就是你现在要对你的人工智能助手说的一切。 无需登录，无需点击日历——预订就这样发生了。 或者问“星期四是什么样子？” 无论您在何处打字，都可以用简单的语言恢复您的日程安排。

今天，我们将为 MakePlans 推出 MCP 服务器，而这正是它可以让您做的事情。

从第一天起，MakePlans 就有了一个 API。 我们的观点始终是，您的数据就是您的数据，您应该能够将 MakePlans 连接到您使用的任何工具，而不是相反。 Claude 和 ChatGPT 等人工智能助手正迅速成为许多人每天使用的工具，因此将它们与您的预订连接起来显然是下一步。

MCP（模型上下文协议）是一种开放标准，可让 AI 助手连接到外部服务。 开放标准是这里的重要部分。 我们没有构建 Claude 插件或 ChatGPT 插件。 我们基于开放协议构建了一个集成，任何使用 MCP 的助手或代理都可以使用它——无论是现在的还是明年的。 这就是我们更喜欢的构建方式。 没有专有的插件商店，没有锁定。

你能做什么

连接后，您的助手可以使用您的 MakePlans 帐户：

  • 检查可用性并找到空缺位置
  • 列出您的服务和活动
  • 查找客户
  • 创建和取消预订

您的助手与 MakePlan 进行对话的方式与我们自己的应用程序的方式相同。 请在我们的人工智能预订助手页面上了解更多有关这一切的信息。

关于访问的注意事项

MCP 服务器适合您和企业。 它使用您自己的 MakePlans API 凭据进行连接，具有与我们的私有 API 相同的访问权限。 这不是您的最终客户将其助手连接到的东西 - 您的客户数据完全保留在原来的位置：在您的帐户中，在您的控制之下。

与我们构建的其他一切一样：这是一个补充，而不是替代。 管理面板、API、集成——一切都像以前一样工作。 如果你不喜欢人工智能助手，那对你来说什么也不会改变。

我们的开发者网站上提供了设置说明。 如果您遇到任何奇怪的事情，或者您的助手做了一些我们没有想到的聪明的事情，我们很乐意听到。
